description: Guidelines, onboarding workflows, listing procedures, and direct trade benefits for millet cultivators and farmers.
overview: MilletVerse is committed to empowering grain farmers by establishing a direct bridge between agricultural producers, home bakers, food manufacturers, and conscious consumers, removing exploitative middlemen and ensuring fair farmgate compensation.

step_1_registration.title: Farmer / Producer Registration
step_1_registration.action: Sign up on MilletVerse through the Farmer Portal or Seller Registration selecting 'Agricultural Producer / Farmer' role. Provide basic details including name, farm location, contact number, and Aadhaar/Kisan identification.

step_2_raw_material_details.title: Raw Material Listing Details
step_2_raw_material_details.action: Submit listing details for the harvested millet raw material:
required_fields: Millet Grain Type: (e.g., Ragi / Finger Millet, Bajra / Pearl Millet, Jowar / Sorghum, Foxtail, etc.)
Form: Whole grain, unhulled, hulled, unpolished, or de-stoned grain
Quantity Available: Total stock in kilograms (kg) or quintals (100 kg units)
Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ): Minimum batch size for buyers (e.g., 50 kg for home bakers or 500 kg for commercial processors)
Harvest Date & Season: Kharif or Rabi harvest month and year
Farming Methodology: Certified Organic, Natural / ZBNF (Zero Budget Natural Farming), or Conventional
Base Price per Quintal / Kilogram: Transparent farmgate asking price in INR (₹)

step_3_quality_verification.title: Quality Verification & Moisture Check
step_3_quality_verification.action: MilletVerse partner agronomists or certified aggregation centers conduct quick moisture tests (target < 12% moisture for safe grain storage) and foreign matter grading before certification badge is awarded.

step_4_live_on_marketplace.title: Live Listing & Buyer Matching
step_4_live_on_marketplace.action: The raw material listing goes live on the MilletVerse B2B/B2C sourcing exchange, where home bakers, bakeries, and consumers can place bulk or wholesale orders directly.

logistics_and_payment_terms.transport_support: MilletVerse coordinates partnered rural freight logistics to pick up bulk grain consignments directly from farmgate or village aggregation hubs.
logistics_and_payment_terms.direct_payout: Payments are directly deposited into the farmer's registered bank account via secure NEFT/RTGS/UPI upon delivery confirmation and inspection.
logistics_and_payment_terms.zero_hidden_commission: Clear, transparent low platform convenience fee without predatory broker deductions.

frequently_asked_farmer_questions.question: Can individual smallholder farmers list smaller harvests?
frequently_asked_farmer_questions.answer: Yes. Farmers can list quantities as low as 25kg or pool their yield with local Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) on MilletVerse.

frequently_asked_farmer_questions.question: Does MilletVerse buy directly or connect with buyers?
frequently_asked_farmer_questions.answer: MilletVerse provides both direct platform sourcing for our marketplace sellers and an open listing exchange for registered food enterprises, bakers, and consumers.
